name: Textura de Poros Faciales
algorithm: Facial Pore Texture — Análisis Espacial a Nivel de Píxel
mechanism:
This method analyzes facial pore texture for deepfake detection at the micro-detail level:

1. **Pore Detección**: Individual skin pores are detected in high-resolution facial regions using morphological operators and local contrast enhancement. Pore density, size distribution, and spatial arrangement are measured — human skin has approximately 250-300 pores per cm² on the face with region-dependent variation.

2. **Pore Patrón Análisis**: Natural pore patterns exhibit specific spatial statistics — approximately regular spacing with random perturbation (a "blue noise" pattern) determined by follicle biology. The method analyzes the spatial point process of detected pores. AI-generated pores may show: too regular spacing (grid-like), too random spacing, or complete absence in supposedly textured skin areas.

3. **Pore - Scale Textura Consistencia**: The texture within each pore (depth, shadowing, surrounding skin quality) should be consistent with the illumination direction and skin region. The method verifies intra-pore rendering quality. AI generators often produce pore textures with incorrect shadow directions or uniform appearance regardless of facial curvature.

4. **Temporal Pore Estabilidad**: Pores have fixed spatial positions — they don't move between frames. The method tracks pore positions over time. Frame-to-frame pore position shifts, appearing/disappearing pores, or changing pore sizes indicate per-frame independent rendering by AI generators.

5. **Regional Pore Distribución**: Pore density and size vary characteristically across facial regions — larger pores on the nose, medium on cheeks, finer on forehead. The method checks whether the detected pore distribution follows anatomical expectations. AI generators often produce spatially uniform pore patterns ignoring regional anatomical variation.
parameters:
Tipo de análisis: píxel
Medio: video
Entrada: Video frames extracted at key intervals
Salida: Puntuación de confianza (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: Moderada a Alta — 70-88% precisión independiente. Most effective when combined with other video forensic methods. Performance depends on video quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated video through facial pore textoure analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for video authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captura artefactos temporales que el análisis de cuadro único pierde
• Funciona con formatos de video estándar
• Efectivo contra técnicas comunes de deepfake
• Se puede combinar con otros métodos forenses de video
• Basado en investigación establecida de visión por computadora
limitations:
• Rendimiento afectado por la compresión y resolución del video
• Algunos métodos requieren suficiente cantidad de cuadros para el análisis temporal
• La efectividad varía según la técnica de generación de deepfake
• Se usa mejor como parte de un pipeline integral de múltiples métodos
• Puede producir falsos positivos en videos auténticos con edición intensiva
